scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env.development -e .env -- concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && dotenv -e .env.development -e .env -- npm run build -w client
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean -w client && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && dotenv -e .env.production -e .env -- npm run build:prod -w client
scripts.start:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -e .env -- concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w client" "npm run start:prod -w server"
